text:
marta.hr: Heads-up Congrats, Leo! Quick checklist for people taking leave this quarter: Workday request, benefits opt-in, and 1-page phased return plan.

leo.engineering: Thanks! My baby is due late July. I'm aiming for leave from Jul 15 3 weeks, plus a 6-week phased return. What are the exact payroll deadlines?

marta.hr: For a Jul 15 start we need Workday submitted by Jun 20 to ensure June payroll cycles pick up the top-up. Company top-up aligns with state FMLA but we do a 2-pay-period processing buffer so earlier is safer.

leo.engineering: Understood. Is the "phased return" a formal program or just manager agreement? Any template for the 1-pager?

tyra.pops: Phased return is formal: up to 12 weeks part-time or reduced schedule, prorated paid benefit. Use the template in People Ops > Leave > Phased Return Template (I can DM the doc). Manager sign-off + People Ops sign-off required. No extra legal sign-off unless you're in a different country.

leo.engineering: Great. What about coverage for my PagerDuty shifts? I can train a buddy but want to avoid surprises. How do I request temporary on-call swaps?

marta.hr: Put swap requests in the #eng-oncall channel and add the planned swap window in the phased plan. Engineering team leads usually approve schedules; People Ops can help coordinate if multiple swaps impact capacity.

leo.engineering: Any paperwork for the childcare stipend? How soon after returning does it start?

tyra.pops: Childcare stipend ($600/month for first 6 months) starts the first full payroll after you move from leave to active status. You enroll in the benefits portal > Family Support. No manager approval needed; just enroll and People Ops will confirm.

hr-bot: Action required: Attach birth/adoption paperwork to ticket #LR-2026-110 within 30 days to maintain processing.

leo.engineering: Cool. I'll submit Workday by Jun 10 and drop the phased template in here for review. Thanks both.

marta.hr: Happy to review the template when you post it. Also: if you want a stay-in-touch plan or occasional check-ins, we can schedule recurring 30-min syncs during leave so rollbacks are smoother. :calendar:
